<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>true</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sc_req_item</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>OS Request based on Department</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var requester = current.requested_for; //
    var user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");

    if (user.get(requester)) {
        var department = user.department.getDisplayValue(); 
        var os = current.variables.select_operating_system + ""; 

        var authorizedDepts = ["IT", "Development"];

        if (os === "appleos" && authorizedDepts.indexOf(department) === -1) {
            gs.addErrorMessage("Only IT or Development staff can request an Apple Machine.");
            current.setAbortAction(true);
        }
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-09-09 13:26:31</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>36c1b77a93b3aa5005b6367efaba107c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OS Request based on Department</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="MyServiceDesk" source="x_1808462_mysdesk">bcb2fd1c935ba25005b6367efaba10ed</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="MyServiceDesk">bcb2fd1c935ba25005b6367efaba10ed</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_36c1b77a93b3aa5005b6367efaba107c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-09-10 00:38:42</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=36c1b77a93b3aa5005b6367efaba107c"/></record_update>
